crossRefs.note: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
translations.bsb: So Mordecai went and did all that Esther had instructed him.

translations.asv: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.
